name: Guagenia
description: Guagenia was a planet located in the Guagenia system, within the Guagenian sector of the Inner Rim and the Interior regions. It was situated in grid square J-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. In 34 ABY, Guagenia was depicted on a galactic map included in the book Traveler's Guide to Batuu, which was written by historian Eloc Throno and detailed the Outer Rim planet Batuu.
